name: Asia Netcom
summary: Pan-Asian submarine-cable carrier; merged with Pacific Internet to form Pacnet in 2008.

events.details: Formed 2002 when a China Netcom-led consortium bought bankrupt Asia Global Crossing's assets (EAC cable) for ~US$120m; China Netcom took full ownership late 2003.
Merged with Pacific Internet under a new corporate name, Pacnet Limited (8 Jan 2008).
